authors: Wang, Xiaosong; Peng, Yifan; Lu, Le; Lu, Zhiyong; Bagheri, Mohammadhadi; Summers, Ronald M.
title: ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases
description: The original release describes report-derived labels for eight findings and 108,948 frontal images. Later ChestX-ray14 updates must be distinguished from that original release. Our pediatric binary dataset is different.

authors: Rajpurkar, Pranav; Irvin, Jeremy; Zhu, Kaylie; Yang, Brandon; Mehta, Hershel; Duan, Tony; Ding, Daisy; Bagul, Aarti; Langlotz, Curtis; Shpanskaya, Katie; Lungren, Matthew P.; Ng, Andrew Y.
title: CheXNet: Radiologist-Level Pneumonia Detection on Chest X-Rays with Deep Learning
description: The reported radiologist comparison concerns pneumonia F1 on a specific test and annotation setup. It motivates a DenseNet baseline but does not establish universal clinical superiority or validate our models.

authors: Irvin, Jeremy; Rajpurkar, Pranav; Ko, Michael; Yu, Yifan; Ciurea-Ilcus, Silviana; Chute, Chris; Marklund, Henrik; Haghgoo, Behzad; Ball, Robyn; Shpanskaya, Katie; Seekins, Jayne; Mong, David A.; Halabi, Safwan S.; Sandberg, Jesse K.; Jones, Ricky; Larson, David B.; Langlotz, Curtis P.; Patel, Bhavik N.; Lungren, Matthew P.; Ng, Andrew Y.
title: CheXpert: A Large Chest Radiograph Dataset with Uncertainty Labels and Expert Comparison
description: CheXpert provides report-derived observation labels with uncertainty and a focused expert comparison. We do not use that dataset or claim to reproduce its multi-finding evaluation.

authors: Bressem, Keno K.; Adams, Lisa C.; Erxleben, Christoph; Hamm, Bernd; Niehues, Stefan M.; Vahldiek, Janis L.
title: Comparing different deep learning architectures for classification of chest radiographs
description: The authors compared sixteen architectures on CheXpert and a separate COVID-19 collection. Comparable shallower models motivate measuring resource costs; their dataset-specific scores are not our results.

authors: Ke, Alexander; Ellsworth, William; Banerjee, Oishi; Ng, Andrew Y.; Rajpurkar, Pranav
title: CheXtransfer: Performance and Parameter Efficiency of ImageNet Models for Chest X-Ray Interpretation
description: The study evaluates transfer and truncation on CheXpert, reporting an average parameter-efficiency improvement without a statistically significant drop in its comparison. That does not prove equivalence; our fine-tuning control does not reproduce truncation.

authors: Yang, Jiancheng; Shi, Rui; Wei, Donglai; Liu, Zequan; Zhao, Lin; Ke, Bilian; Pfister, Hanspeter; Ni, Bingbing
title: MedMNIST v2 - A large-scale lightweight benchmark for 2D and 3D biomedical image classification
description: The 2023 paper describes the standardized MedMNIST v2 collection at 28-pixel resolution. Our actual 224-pixel MedMNIST+ file is identified separately by its release record and checksum, rather than being an upscaled copy of the paper's 28-pixel images.
